title: Metasploit Wrap Up: A Collection of What Can Only Be Called Eclectic Modules
body_markdown:
I’m not sure how else to describe this release’s module content. Four modules targeting LLMs, two Linux LPE’s, 12 Windows AARCH64 fetch payloads, a TV streaming RCE, and a scanner targeting a CVE from 26 years ago? It is a privilege to work with committers and contributors with such varied passions, and who knows, next release we might have a Novell Netware module and then we really will party like it’s 1999!


## New module content (12)


### vLLM Multimodal Heap-Address Information Leak Scanner


Author: Kenneth LaCroix


Type: Auxiliary


Pull request:[#21592](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21592) contributed by[kenlacroix](https://github.com/kenlacroix)


Path:` scanner/http/vllm_multimodal_info_leak`


CVE reference:[CVE-2026-22778](https://www.rapid7.com/db/vulnerabilities/cve-2026-22778/)


Description: This adds an auxiliary scanner module vllm_multimodal_info_leak that detects vLLM OpenAI-compatible servers affected by CVE-2026-22778. The aforementioned CVE tracks a vulnerability that when an invalid image is sent to vLLM's multimodal endpoint, PIL throws an error which contains a heap address that can be chained with a heap overflow to achieve RCE on the target system.

### Linux PAM Backdoor


Author: h00die


Type: Post


Pull request:[#21516](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21516) contributed by[h00die](https://github.com/h00die)


Path:` linux/manage/pam_backdoor`


Description: Adds a module allowing a user to upload a pam so file (or compile on system if not x64) into the auth chain.


## Enhancements and features (4)


- [#21680](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21680) from[messede-degod](https://github.com/messede-degod) - This updates the` post/linux/gather/enum_protections` module to detect AV/EDR inside the target system.
- [#21887](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21887) from[dwelch-r7](https://github.com/dwelch-r7) - Adds a Rake-based module generator (` rake msf:generate\[TYPE,PATH,PLATFORM,ARCH\]` ) that scaffolds new modules skeletons for all available module types, together with a matching documentation skeleton under` documentation/modules/` .
- [#21935](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21935) from[jheysel-r7](https://github.com/jheysel-r7) - Adds additional fingerprint support for Gitlab 19.0.0-19.4.0.
- [#21936](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21936) from[satanonsteroids2024-zzz](https://github.com/satanonsteroids2024-zzz) - Improves` msfvenom` option handling error message.


## Bugs fixed (8)


- [#21548](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21548) from[msutovsky-r7](https://github.com/msutovsky-r7) - Adds documentation and Improves reliability for fileless fetch payloads using the shell-search option on systems where anonymous file handles either don't exist or existing user does not have permission to write the payload into them.
- [#21878](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21878) from[Benziza](https://github.com/Benziza) - Fixes` search type:-aux` so the aux shorthand correctly excludes auxiliary modules, matching the behavior of` search type:-auxiliary` .
- [#21882](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21882) from[revanth3205](https://github.com/revanth3205) - Fixes some` exists?` checks to now more accurately check for` .directory?` in several modules.
- [#21906](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21906) from[Pushpenderrathore](https://github.com/Pushpenderrathore) - Fixes a bug in the Web Enrollment library where a dropped connection or timeout between the request to create the certificate and the request to download the certificate. Previously the timeout was unhandled which caused the module to stop without downloading the certificate that had been created. This change handles the exception and prints out the warning.
- [#21923](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21923) from[kx7m2qd](https://github.com/kx7m2qd) - Fixes some` exists?` checks to now more accurately check for` .directory?` and` writable?` in several modules.
- [#21959](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21959) from[revanth3205](https://github.com/revanth3205) - Fixes missing` ip:port` prefixes for the console output in the MSSQL and SSH login scanners.
- [#21969](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21969) from[pauljccode](https://github.com/pauljccode) - Freeze time in the rate limiter concurrency spec.
- [#21982](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21982) from[kx7m2qd](https://github.com/kx7m2qd) - Fixes duplicate` ip:port` prefixes in the output of the PostgreSQL login scanner.
